propositions: Configuration ownership must be centrally enforced via a deterministic AST gate that rejects direct ambient reads, environment variable access, backend property reloads, and bypasses outside approved composition seams.

Legacy ambient and per-job configuration facades, migration switches, and exception entries must be removed only after ownership registry is complete, all synthetic and behavioral test suites pass, and bounded provider/AWS/reconciler canaries are verified.
Approved configuration and credential names must be derived from an authoritative registry with exactly one owner per name; broad path globs and unrationed exceptions are prohibited.
Configuration lifecycle, security, operator documentation, and behavioral precedence must be generated from the authoritative schema and ownership registries and kept byte-current.
The ownership AST gate and field-consumption gate must both execute in make lint and CI, and neither can silently be omitted.
S1-S6 behavioral test suites must remain the correctness oracle; the structural AST gate is a change detector supplement, not a replacement.
